learningObjectives: Explain the role of middleware in a backend application.
Organize backend code into maintainable architectural layers.
Trace how requests move through middleware and route handlers.

activities.title: Backend Layer Map
activities.instruction: Map requests across the major backend layers.

content.concept: A layered backend separates routing, business logic, data access, and infrastructure concerns.

activities.title: Middleware Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a middleware function.

content.concept: Middleware can inspect requests, modify responses, perform checks, and pass control to the next handler.

activities.title: Request Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange middleware in the correct request sequence.

content.concept: Backend requests can pass through logging, authentication, validation, routing, and error-handling stages.

activities.title: Backend Structure Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a maintainable backend project structure.

content.concept: Separating controllers, services, repositories, routes, and configuration improves backend maintainability.
